## Summary / Что изменено


## Safety impact / Влияние на безопасность

- [ ] SSH behavior changed
- [ ] Firewall or Docker/VPN networking changed
- [ ] Rollback or file deletion behavior changed
- [ ] No security-sensitive behavior changed

## Validation / Проверка

- [ ] `bash tests/smoke.sh`
- [ ] ShellCheck warning severity or stricter
- [ ] PowerShell parser (if `.ps1` changed)
- [ ] No keys, tokens, `.env` contents, real IPs, or unredacted logs included

## Recovery / Откат

Describe how an administrator recovers if this change fails.
